title_en: Graduation Thesis Submission for Undergraduate Students Expected to Graduate in February 2027
summary: Students who have applied to graduate in February 2027 as primary majors or double majors (including the College of Liberal Studies [자유전공학부]) must submit a graduation thesis to the school administrative office by Monday, 21 December 2026. Students who cannot meet this deadline must submit a Graduation Thesis Submission Date Confirmation form by the same date and then submit the thesis by Monday, 28 December 2026.
applies_to: Primary majors and double majors (including the College of Liberal Studies [자유전공학부]) among those who have applied to graduate in February 2027. A graduation thesis cannot be submitted by a student who is not graduating. Students who previously submitted a report for completion of the graduation project must also submit a thesis in the attached format.

steps: Write your graduation thesis following the attached thesis writing guidelines. If you previously submitted a report for completion of the graduation project, you must also rewrite it in the attached thesis format.
On the outer cover, write the date as "2027.2". On the approval page [인준지], write the year, month and day on which your thesis advisor signs it, and obtain your thesis advisor's signature.
Write your student ID number in pencil at the bottom of the cover. Double majors write "복수" and College of Liberal Studies students write "자유" in pencil before the student ID number.

translation:
Title: Graduation Thesis Submission for Undergraduate Students Expected to Graduate in February 2027

1. Students expected to graduate in February 2027 should refer to the attached graduation thesis writing guidelines and submit their graduation thesis to the school administrative office by the deadline.
(1) Who must submit: Primary majors and double majors (including the College of Liberal Studies [자유전공학부]) among those who have applied to graduate in February 2027.
※ A graduation thesis cannot be submitted alone without graduating.
(2) Graduation thesis submission deadline: by Monday, 21 December 2026.
* Even if your thesis has been written in advance, please do not submit it early; submit it from December onward.
(3) Write your student ID number in pencil at the bottom of the thesis cover.
* Double majors and College of Liberal Studies students should write "복수" (double major) or "자유" (Liberal Studies), respectively, in pencil before the student ID number.
(4) No separate binding is required (the school office will bind all theses together later). Both double-sided and single-sided printing are acceptable. (However, the outer cover and the approval page [인준지] must each be printed single-sided.)

2. Students who, for unavoidable reasons, cannot submit their graduation thesis by the deadline should submit the Graduation Thesis Submission Date Confirmation form [졸업논문제출일 확인서] (form attached) to the staff member in charge in Room 319, Building 301, by Monday, 21 December 2026.
(1) The thesis submission deadline under the Graduation Thesis Submission Date Confirmation form is Monday, 28 December 2026.
(2) The confirmation form must be submitted by Monday, 21 December 2026, and the thesis must be submitted by Monday, 28 December.

3. How to complete the thesis
(1) Outer cover: write "2027.2".
(2) Approval page [인준지]: write the year, month and day on which your thesis advisor signed it.

4. Students who previously submitted a report upon completion of the graduation project must also write their thesis according to the attached graduation thesis format, obtain their thesis advisor's signature, and submit it.

* Inquiries: the department office. The contact person, email address and phone number are given in the original Korean notice.

Attachments (2):
1. 학부졸업논문 작성지침(2024.8.13).hwp (Undergraduate Graduation Thesis Writing Guidelines, dated 2024.8.13)
2. 전기정보공학부_졸업논문_제출일_확인서.hwp (Graduation Thesis Submission Date Confirmation form)

Note: The contents of the attached files were not read and are not included in this translation.
